name: How can I prevent future sewer line problems after repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future sewer line problems after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future sewer line issues, avoid flushing non-biodegradable items like wipes and feminine hygiene products. Be mindful of what goes down your drains, especially grease and food scraps. Consider having your sewer line professionally cleaned every few years, particularly if you have older pipes or trees with invasive root systems nearby. Regular camera inspections can also help identify potential problems early, before they escalate into major repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent problems by avoiding non-flushable items and grease, scheduling regular cleanings, and considering periodic camera inspections.
